name: The False-Layman Bait
description: An admin user sends a support ticket simulating digital incompetence. The attached screenshot shows a dirty pipe exploit mid-execution. However, there's no bash history, no prior download, no process in memory. A single source isn't enough for MALICE.

custodyEvents.detail: Support ticket flagged for review by a human analyst.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Ticket de soporte marcado para revisión por un analista humano.

custodyEvents.detail: Ticket, screenshot and a memory snapshot of the reporting host acquired.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Ticket, captura de pantalla e instantánea de memoria del host que reportó, adquiridos.

custodyEvents.detail: Deterministic engine ran over the acquired artifacts.
custodyEvents.detail_es: El motor determinista corrió sobre los artefactos adquiridos.

artifacts.description: Ticket: 'I don't know what I touched, black screen with green letters, I can't get into Excel'. Attachment: screenshot.png.
artifacts.description_es: Ticket: 'No sé qué toqué, pantalla negra con letras verdes, no entro al Excel'. Adjunto: screenshot.png.

artifacts.description: Screenshot: Linux terminal with CVE-2022-0847 (dirty pipe) at 45%. Requires advanced C knowledge to reach that state. Same provenance root as the ticket — this is an attachment of that same submission, not an independent acquisition.
artifacts.description_es: Captura: terminal Linux con CVE-2022-0847 (dirty pipe) al 45%. Requiere conocimiento avanzado de C para llegar a ese estado.

artifacts.description: Memory scan: no bash history with wget/chmod/exploit. No active suspicious process. No DNS connection to a recent domain. Shows the absence of corroboration; carries no markers itself.
artifacts.description_es: Memory scan: no hay historial bash con wget/chmod/exploit. No hay proceso sospechoso activo. No hay conexión DNS a dominio reciente.

peirce_chain.firstness: Non-technical user's ticket with a kernel-exploit screenshot.
peirce_chain.secondness: No technical corroboration: no history, no process, no network.
peirce_chain.thirdness: There's a strong signal of forensic theater, but a single source. The system resists escalating to MALICE.

demo_quote: The screenshot is alarming, but without memory, network, or a process to corroborate it, VELO stays at SUSPICION. The ticket and its own attachment are one source, not two — the Daubert rule counts independent acquisitions, not files.
description_es: Usuario de administración envía ticket de soporte simulando incompetencia digital. La captura adjunta muestra un exploit dirty pipe a medio ejecutar. Sin embargo, no hay historial bash, no hay descarga previa, no hay proceso en memoria. Una sola fuente no alcanza para MALICE.
demo_quote_es: La captura es alarmante, pero sin memoria, sin red y sin proceso que la corrobore, VELO se queda en SUSPICION. La regla Daubert exige dos fuentes.

peirce_chain_es.firstness: Ticket de usuario no técnico con captura de exploit kernel.
peirce_chain_es.secondness: No hay corroboración técnica: sin historial, sin proceso, sin red.
peirce_chain_es.thirdness: Hay señal fuerte de teatro forense, pero una sola fuente. El sistema se resiste a elevar a MALICE.
